records.description: Splashd's wording refers to the hilltop viewpoint by Honor Oak. CruisingGays separately titles it 'Honor Oak Park – One Tree Hill'; an independent park register confirms the real woodland and viewing point, not recent sexual activity.

records.name: Brookmill Park Lewisham
records.location: Brookmill Park, Brookmill Road, Deptford Bridge, Lewisham SE8 4JG.
records.description: Lewisham Council independently describes a riverside park, water features, play area and nature reserve. Its separate Brookmill Nature Reserve is kept locked except authorised activities, contradicting any suggestion the nature reserve is open to casual nighttime visitors.
records.original_source_description: This park makes for the ideal outdoor cruising site. The park gates are always open. There are plenty of places to discreetly hide away & play with your catch. This place is more suitable for when its darker. People dog walk here, so discretion is a must.
